## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Amsterdam, Netherlands. It starts at 1,Steenstraat.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Get to know the lives of people around the world at Wereldmuseum Leiden, an eye-opening museum of ethnology. Lovingly arranged by cultural region, thousands of objects tell the stories of human experience around the world. Now _that's_ a day well spent!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €12.02. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 77 ratings and 43 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
